value.rationale: For the canonical triconnected planar cube, the three-particle graph-braid configuration space has a natural 17-dimensional degree-two homology representation. Its complete symmetry character reveals six rational irreducible types, seven summands counting multiplicity, an 8/9 antipodal eigenspace split and absence of full rotational invariants, none of which follows from ordinary Betti ranks or earlier two-particle classification. It provides a precise equivariant test of planar graph-configuration theory rather than an arbitrary parameter slice; no family generalization is asserted.
